Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Designed for active professionals and fitness-focused users, the SmartFit Pro X1 combines sleek style with everyday performance. Its vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display keeps your notifications, workouts, and wellness insights clear at a glance, while Bluetooth calling helps you stay connected without reaching for your phone. With up to 7 days of battery life, it’s built to keep up with your routine.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for bright, sharp, easy-to-read visuals
- Bluetooth calling for convenient communication on the go
- Up to 7-day battery life for fewer interruptions and more freedom
- Heart-rate monitoring to help you stay informed about your wellness
- Sleep tracking for better insight into your nightly recovery
- Fitness activity tracking to support your workout and movement goals
- IP68 waterproof design for confident everyday wear

Promotional Tagline:
Stay connected, track smarter, and move through your day in style.
